name: The Heroine
source: An upbeat herbalist with a bouncy personality. She pulled the protagonist into many fun activities, and the two eventually fell in love. She hopes to one day save enough money to buy a house, and maybe even marry her beloved. Although she lives as the embodiment of love, at times she seems to harbour a deep hatred for the world.
